globalSettlementBiddingInfo:
{{symbol}} is in global settlement. Its outstanding debt can be covered by collateral bids, each pairing additional {{collateral}} with an amount of debt covered. If all debt is covered and every included bid meets the initial collateral requirement (ICR) at maintenance, {{symbol}} revives and each winning bid opens as a margin position.

Bids are ranked by price, best first; the first bid with insufficient collateral stops inclusion and the rest are reimbursed. Bids count toward coverage even before fresh feeds arrive, and can be withdrawn at any time with a zero-collateral bid. {{symbol}} can also revive if the feed price rises above the auto revive price, or once all debt is force settled.
globalSettlementReviveInfo: Asset will automatically revive if its feed price becomes greater than the auto revive price (bids included) or all debt is force settled.
holderForceSettleDescription: During Global Settlement there is no delay in asset force settlements, which will be covered by the settlement funds at the fixed settlement price.

alreadyReviving: Existing bids already cover the debt with sufficient collateral — this asset should revive at the next maintenance.
bidWillHelpRevive: This bid covers the outstanding debt and helps cure {{asset}}'s black-swan overhang — full revival follows once fresh feeds let the collateral check pass.
revivePendingFeed: no fresh feeds yet — your bid still helps cure the black-swan overhang, and full revival follows once feed producers publish.
reviveHelpsNoFeed: every bid helps cure the black-swan overhang — ~{{amount}} {{asset}} still to cover, then full revival follows once fresh feeds are published.
reviveHelpPendingFeed: debt covered — full revival follows once fresh feeds let the {{kind}} check pass at maintenance.
reviveBlockedNoFeed: No fresh feeds yet — your bid still helps cure the black-swan overhang, and full revival follows once feed producers publish.
reviveBlockedPM: Prediction-market assets cannot be revived by collateral bids.
reviveNeedsCollateral: insufficient collateral for {{kind}} — add ~{{amount}} {{collateral}} more (or cover less debt) to revive.
reviveBlockedByBid: bid #{{failing}} ahead of you lacks sufficient collateral ({{kind}}), so later bids would not be included.
reviveNeedsDebt: covers debt but ~{{amount}} {{asset}} still uncovered — increase debt covered to revive.
reviveNotEnough: this bid alone would not revive {{asset}}.
marketBuyDescription: Buy it on the open market and force settle it — every settled debt brings the asset closer to automatic revival.
